title: potentilla argentea var. neglecta
intro: Potentilla argentea var. neglecta, commonly known as silver cinquefoil, is a plant species within the Rosaceae family, characterized by its silvery-gray leaves and white or pink flowers. The plant is known to have several health benefits, including the ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Potentilla argentea var. neglecta include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
